verdict.rationale: Supermemory exposes a full API/SDK for ingestion, search, memory graph, profiles, container tags, and document CRUD (supermemory-docs-1,10,23,26,27,60), covering most core UI functionality. However, some UI-surfaced features like connectors (Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, GitHub) appear managed via OAuth/settings flows rather than fully API-driven, and no official OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (probe-2 shows 404s), making full API parity hard to verify. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/swagger spec confirming full API surface parity, explicit API endpoints for connector management/setup mirroring UI flows, and independent confirmation that all UI actions (e.g., buckets, MemoryBench runs) have API equivalents.
